name: Diet And Nutrition
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided humanity with plants and fruits for food, as seen in Genesis 1:29, and later expanded dietary allowances to include animals while maintaining divine guidelines (Genesis 9:3). The Mosaic Law further instructs the Israelites to avoid consuming certain fats and blood, emphasizing holiness and obedience in their diet (Leviticus 3:17; 7:23). Detailed distinctions between clean and unclean animals, such as the prohibition against eating camels because they do not fully meet God's criteria, underscore the importance of following God's established dietary commands (Leviticus 11:1, 4).
